about_the_game:
Build beautiful 3D dioramas that come to life! No quests, no timers and no leveling – just a relaxed experience to tackle at your own pace. This is the flat screen adaptation of the indie VR hit with over 3.000 reviews. 

Pick your puzzle: Want to visit the towering Sphynx? Dive to the sea floor? Join Dracula for dinner? Or puzzle a cute spice stand from a Turkish Bazaar? Explore over 30 intricate puzzles made from 3D scans of real world locations - and some made from our favourite games!

Looking for a quick, 5min puzzle snack in between tasks? Or that epic, multi hour challenge for a rainy weekend? Our two game modes and different pieces counts got you covered: 

  • Tabletop Mode: start with all the pieces, sort arrange and build the fractured diorama piece by piece like a real world jigsaw.

  • Snack Mode: Short on time? Build your puzzle a handful of curated pieces at a time! Ideal for flow and building puzzles over multiple quick sessions!

  • Each puzzle is available in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400 pieces - and some even 800 or 1000 pieces! 

Whatever you’re in the mood for, Puzzling Places can offer a satisfying refuge from the bustle of everyday life.

Lean back and puzzle on your Steam Deck, get serious on your desktop PC or even step inside the puzzle with your VR headset - Puzzling Places has been optimized across different devices!

Features:

  • 30+ intricate dioramas from around the world - each coming to life with a handcrafted soundscape and little stories to discover

  • No timers, tasks or pressure - puzzle at your own pace

  • 2 game modes: complete puzzles in short bursts in Snack Mode or go for the full depth in Tabletop Mode 

  • Adjustable difficulty: each puzzle comes in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400 - and some up to 1000 pieces

  • Cross-Device: puzzle on your desktop, your Steamdeck or in your VR headset

About the developers

Founded in 2016, Realities.io is a pioneer of 3D photography. Realities.io’s technology has powered the early Steam VR app Realities, a number of award winning VR films and experiences, including Home After War, which was awarded “Best Use of Immersive Arts” at SXSW 2019, and the megahit VR puzzle game Puzzling Places.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel i5 7th gen or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 970 or similar
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: optional: SteamVR compatible or Meta Quest headset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel i7 7th gen or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 980 Ti or similar
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • VR Support: optional: SteamVR compatible or Meta Quest headset

short_description: Arrange, connect and relax as you puzzle satisfying 3D dioramas of beautiful locations from around the world! No quests, no timers, no pressure - just puzzle at your pace, in short dips or epic puzzle sessions!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
